description: LLM report-stage latency per model on identical input (7 candidate incidents from samples/person-bicycle-car.mp4, hybrid sampling, max gap 2s, --start-time 2026-11-16T23:58:40). Collected in Phase 2; to be folded into the Phase 5 benchmarks.
machine: Apple M4, macOS (Darwin 25.6.0), Python 3.11.18, anthropic SDK 2.9.0
notes: Network/API latency dominates and varies between runs; single full-pipeline runs overstate the gap. Medians of 3 back-to-back runs: Sonnet 5.5 is ~13% faster (1.04s).
